enrichment.headline: Awards Deco Tech Systems $240,500 for new security cameras and door intercoms at Oakland High
enrichment.summary: Deco Tech Systems, the lowest responsive bidder, would install, replace and repair security cameras at Oakland High School (about 4 new, 102 replacements and 5 repairs) and install a door entry intercom system. The $240,500 includes a $21,500 contingency allowance. Work is expected to run 90 days, from January 18, 2023 to April 17, 2023.
